description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to message output and publishing within the WPEFramework project. It includes abstract interfaces for publishing messages, concrete implementations for console, syslog, file, JSON formatted output, UDP, and WebSocket outputs, as well as a JSON data structure for message metadata. The file is primarily used for message handling and output formatting in the system.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for message publishing with a virtual Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for converting message info and text into a formatted string.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to the console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that writes messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Class for formatting message metadata into JSON, with options for including various fields.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that sends messages over UDP.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that manages WebSocket connections for message output, including command handling for export options.
